title: Prisma through PgBouncer or the Supabase pooler fails with 'prepared statement "s0" already exists'
symptoms: prisma migrate deploy fails or hangs when the CLI URL points at the pooler port 6543
cause: Transaction-mode poolers do not keep named prepared statements on one session, and Prisma Migrate needs a single direct connection that poolers do not provide.
fix: Give the CLI a direct connection and the client the pooled one. On Prisma 6, add pgbouncer=true to the pooled URL only for PgBouncer before 1.21 and configure max_prepared_statements on 1.21 and later; the Prisma 7 docs do not say whether @prisma/adapter-pg reads pgbouncer=true.
affected: Prisma ORM 6 and 7 with transaction-mode PgBouncer or Supavisor, as of October 2026; vendor policy, re-check by 2026-12-15
